name: add_primitive_object
description: G-2: a Blank pipeline project (F-2) gets a shape without an asset. Add Object > Cube sends one spawn of engine://primitives/cube; the Outliner shows Cube and selects it, and the Inspector's model field reads the primitive. Add material pass... on Blank's graph root is the Graph's palette (GL-5c): forward_opaque_v1 goes into the graph's nodes with its draw loop and its own images; the Blank pipeline has no pass for deferred materials and the primitive's default grey is automatic, so the forward route default goes with the edit and Studio restarts the engine on the same project. present reading the pass's colour output (dragged onto its + input on the Graph) through the Blank pipeline's engine://passthrough (VI-2), with no shader written, then puts a grey box on screen. A second Cube is named Cube_001.
